headline: 49ers Owner Jed York Handed Six-Game Suspension
summary: Jed York’s Ohio arrest as part of a prostitution sting this summer has brought NFL consequences. The league handed the 49ers owner a six-game suspension Friday, ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports. headline: Ravens OLB Trey Hendrickson Undergoes Finger Surgery, Will Miss Week 4
summary: The Ravens will go without star pass rusher Trey Hendrickson against the Titans on Sunday. Head coach Jesse Minter announced Hendrickson underwent finger surgery, adding that the outside linebacker’s absence should be “very, very short term” (via Jamison Hensley of ESPN). Hendrickson broke his finger in the Ravens’ 41-23 win in Indianapolis in Week 1. […]

headline: Liam Coen on Travis Hunter's usage: "He cares about winning"
summary: Questions have persisted regarding whether the Jaguars are getting the most out of cornerback/receiver Travis Hunter, the second overall pick in the 2025 draft.
